title.value: A rapid review for developing a co-design framework for a pediatric surgical communication application
title.justification: The title accurately represents the focus of the paper, which is a review to develop a co-design framework for a pediatric surgical application.
title.quote: A rapid review for developing a co-design framework for a pediatric surgical communication application

extractions.description: This paper presents a rapid review aimed at developing a co-design framework for a pediatric surgical communication application. The review synthesizes existing studies on co-design in the context of mobile health applications, emphasizing participatory design involving end-users, particularly for pediatric care. The study outlines methods, stakeholder involvement, and the potential impact of co-design on mobile health application successes.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on healthcare communication application development rather than climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This review aims to summarize previously published uses of co-design in mHealth applications. It will inform the development of a local mHealth tool in pediatric surgery.

primary_category.justification: The subject of the paper does not align with the predefined categories related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development as it focuses on healthcare communication technologies.
primary_category.quote: This study followed the Cochrane Rapid Review Guidelines [15] and methodological guidance from the Virginia Commonwealth University [16]. Our protocol included the following steps: 1) identifying a research question, 2) setting eligibility criteria, 3) designing and executing a search strategy, 4) screening and selecting studies using an iterative team approach, 5) data extraction, and 6) data synthesis.
